summary: The explicitly authorized six-structure held-out VASP TS-domain force-label batch was geometry-gated, submitted as LSF jobs 9719408-9719413, and registered; all six initial scheduler states were PEND and no scientific result is yet established.

payload.objective: Establish whether the current AQCat25 checkpoint can be calibrated for the Fe(110) hydrogen-transfer TS/path domain before using it to accelerate the remaining C* + H* -> CH* transition-state search.
current_evidence: The frozen six-structure local geometry gate passed for R1, R2, S1, S2, F1, and F2 without atom-order, fixed-layer, cell, PBC, or continuity errors.
The user explicitly authorized this bounded six-job VASP force-label batch.
R1/R2/S1/S2/F1/F2 were submitted to sunboquan-codex as LSF jobs 9719408/9719409/9719410/9719411/9719412/9719413.
Every submitted job is an exact-structure static label using NSW=0, IBRION=-1, ENCUT=400 eV, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV, EDIFF=1e-6 eV, ISPIN=2, and a 5x5x1 Gamma mesh.
Initial live scheduler evidence recorded all six jobs as PEND; scheduler status alone does not establish electronic convergence, complete forces, or scientific validity.

All six calculations, jobs, initial status rows, provenance files, and compatibility records were appended to data/project_registry.sqlite3 by registry batch fe110-c-h-to-ch-heldout-labels-9719408-9719413-20260820.
These six structures remain independent held-out validation labels and are excluded from training/replay for the checkpoint under evaluation.
payload.one_executable_step: Wait for all six jobs to reach a terminal scheduler state, collect OUTCAR and OSZICAR, and verify normal termination, electronic convergence, and complete 47-atom force data before any exact AQCat25 comparison.
payload.submission_boundary: This submission does not authorize automatic reruns, parameter changes, GPU prediction, fine-tuning, ML-NEB reruns, VASP NEB/CI-NEB, DIMER, frequency, connectivity, or barrier reporting.
done_when: At least five disjoint held-out VASP-labeled TS-domain structures pass registered calibration metrics for the exact checkpoint and compatibility branch.
A hash-bound calibration review decides whether this checkpoint is reusable for the in-scope hydrogen-transfer path domain.
Only after calibration may the strategy engine choose the least-cost VASP NEB/CI-NEB/DIMER continuation from the complete path evidence.
